text: dsh-vedar 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的堪察加旅游 MCP 接入插件。它通过配置补丁注册官方 MCP 客户端，并连接 Vedar 服务。用户可借助服务工具查询旅游项目与可用情况、了解地点和路线信息，并规划行程。适合需要在 DSH 中查询堪察加旅游信息的用户。无需额外 API 密钥；连接使用 Vedar 的在线服务。

dsh-vedar connects DeepSeek Harness to Vedar’s Kamchatka travel MCP service by registering the official MCP client. Users can query tours and availability, retrieve place and route information, and plan trips through Vedar’s online tools. No extra API key is configured.
想在 DSH 里查堪察加有哪些旅游项目和空位。
帮我了解堪察加的地点、路线情况并安排一趟行程。
I want to plan a Kamchatka trip using travel information from my DSH session.
dsh-vedar 的功能「查询旅游与可用情况」：通过接入 Vedar MCP 服务，向其旅游工具查询项目和实时可用情况；请求由远程服务处理。连接地址配置为 https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp。
dsh-vedar 的功能「获取地点信息并规划行程」：将 Vedar MCP 工具接入 DSH，供会话查询地点和路线信息、规划堪察加旅行。具体数据由所连接的 Vedar 服务提供。
dsh-vedar 使用前须知：插件将 MCP 请求发送到 vedarai.ru 的 /api/mcp 端点以调用旅游服务；源码未配置 API 密钥。

dsh-vedar README · dsh-vedar — Vedar (Kamchatka travel) MCP server for DeepSeek Harness：[中文](README.zh.md)

**Vedar** (vedarai.ru, Russian name Ведар) is the travel platform of the Kamchatka peninsula, Russia. Its public MCP server gives AI agents live tours and availability from local operators, the safety status of places and routes (volcanoes, earthquakes, weather warnings), weather, stays, gear rental, transfers and trip plans. No auth, rate-limited by IP.

text: dsh-vedar README · dsh-vedar — Vedar (Kamchatka travel) MCP server for DeepSeek Harness：This plugin does one thing: it registers one instance of the official bridge `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` in your DeepSeek Harness profile, pointed at `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`. After install the model calls the tools as `mcp__vedar__<tool>`.

dsh-vedar README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tourhabk-ui/dsh-vedar
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm, so pnpm must be on PATH (`npm i -g pnpm`); without it the command stops with "pnpm was not found".

Restart `dsh web`. The tools appear before the first turn.

No plugin? Put the same row into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (identical to `cordis.patch.yml` in this repository):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-vedar
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
dsh-vedar README · Install：Or add it by URL in a settings panel (`dsh-mcp-center`, `dsh-mcp-panel`, `dsh-mcp-connector`): type Streamable HTTP, URL `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`, auth none.

dsh-vedar README · Tools (20)：Read: `get_tours`, `get_tour_details`, `get_tour_availability`, `get_place_info`, `get_volcano_status`, `safety_status`, `get_guardian_context`, `get_weather`, `search_accommodations`, `search_gear`, `search_transfers`, `make_trip_plan`, `edit_trip_plan`, `get_request_status`, `search`, `fetch`.

Write, four requests confirmed by a human, no online payment: `create_lead`, `create_booking_request`, `create_stay_request`, `request_charter`.
dsh-vedar README · Tools (20)：Platform data is in Russian; tool arguments work best in Russian or English. Emergency number in Kamchatka: 112.

The row in this plugin follows the README of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 0.2.0-rc.2 (checked 2026-10-13). Verified end to end on 2026-10-14 with dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and pnpm 10.28.0 (headless profile, GitHub Actions runner): the plugin installed with the command above, and DeepSeek answered a Chinese question about brown bears in August by calling 17 Vedar tools, all completed. Please report problems at [tourhabk-ui/pos](https://github.com/tourhabk-ui/pos/issues).
